run_gen_link_script: run gen_link_script.py to generate a linker script that links libc++ to the proper ABI library
run_gen_link_script_dryrun: run gen_link_script.py with --dryrun to preview the linker script without replacing the symlink
parse_args_parse_cli: parse command line arguments for the symlink file path and list of public libraries to link
print_and_exit_error: print an error message to stderr and exit with status code 1
help_and_exit_usage: print detailed usage help for gen_link_script.py including arguments and exit status
